notes: Both promoted advisories cover R_2_6_2 by their published ranges: CVE-2025-59375 (before 2.7.2) and CVE-2026-66046 (introduced 0, last_affected R_2_8_3).

CVE-2026-66046 is located by fix-diff comparison against f8f7c4ff (PR #1321, in R_2_8_4); the loop matches the fix pre-image except for `int j` vs `size_t j`, and the hash-table half of the fix does not exist at 2.6.2.

CVE-2025-59375 is located by source review: the shipped fix (PR #1034 merge ac7a27e1, in R_2_7_2) is a parser-wide MALLOC tracker with no hunk at the tag allocation, so the anchor is the allocation that upstream issue #1018 identifies as the amplification source (120 bytes per 3-byte tag, measured 70.77x).

CVE-2025-66382 remains possible_affected: issue #1076 is open, the details are NDA-bound, there is no fix commit and no locatable public root cause. Its NVD-only sweep duplicate is closed as a duplicate.
OSV GIT "fixed" for CVE-2025-59375 is 7643f96b, a release-prep merge (#1038); it is not used as the fix commit.
